'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Brian Hollingsworth DS Spice Mine Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hollingsworth]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet surname Hollingsworth (inventory Hollingworth). Line 1 K&D; start [[Spice Mine Operations (V)]] at L8 (SMO archetype). L26 Victory! → Victory-Class Star Destroyer (V). L51 Always Thinking With Your Stomach. L58 U-3PO. L59 We're In Attack Position Now (sheet patch). Shield8 We'll Let Fate Decide, Huh? (V) (sheet Rats Decide Hub).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Spice Mine Operations (V) (Virtual Block 6)|Spice Mine Operations (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
